meta.title: The Connected AgileMind (Test): Your AI Integration Roadmap
meta.subtitle: From Crystal's manual invoicing loop to AgentForce — your three-stage roadmap

challenge.lead: Before the solution — there are real questions left to answer: QuickBooks Online or Desktop, where Holly's spreadsheets live, whether the ISBN lookup table can be built before go-live. Those are worth nailing down — and they can be. Here is what is happening right now while those questions sit open: Crystal Robinson manually creates the QuickBooks invoice, manually transfers the account details and line items from the Salesforce Agreement, and then manually updates the invoice number, date, and payment information back into the Salesforce Agreement using a custom field. At 15 to 30 minutes per agreement, across a back-to-school pipeline that compresses into 60 days — that is the labor cost of the status quo, running every cycle.

cards.label: Crystal's Manual Invoicing Loop
cards.text: Crystal Robinson creates every QuickBooks invoice by hand — entering line items from the Salesforce Agreement, then updating the invoice number, date, and open balance back into Salesforce manually. At 15–30 minutes per agreement, this runs every time Abby closes a deal.

cards.label: Holly's Spreadsheet Is the Only Source
cards.text: The moment Holly Wale closes her laptop, the rest of the team is working from stale inventory data. Maria cannot answer 'what is the current available stock for Intensified Algebra Vol 1?' without calling Holly directly.

cards.label: 60-Day Back-to-School Crunch
cards.text: District POs compress May through July — the same 60-day window where Crystal is manually processing the most invoices and Holly is manually tracking the most inventory demand at the same time. AgileMind (Test)'s April 1 fiscal year means their books open while districts are still spending.

solution.lead: DataSkate manages a MuleSoft runtime between Salesforce, QuickBooks Online, and Holly's inventory worksheet — handling event triggers, field transforms, error recovery, and OAuth token rotation automatically. Unlike native marketplace connectors, the DataSkate layer includes retry logic, dead letter queuing, and an operations layer that runs without internal IT resources. No code changes are required in Salesforce or QuickBooks.
solution.diagramCaption: DataSkate-managed MuleSoft layer — no code changes required in Salesforce or QuickBooks. Salesforce and QuickBooks Online are both source and target: UC1 flows Salesforce → QB; UC2, UC4 flow QB → Salesforce; UC3 flows Google Sheets / Excel → Salesforce.

roi.headline: The business case for moving now
roi.body: Crystal Robinson spends 15–30 minutes manually re-entering data between QuickBooks and Salesforce on every agreement. At AgileMind (Test)'s back-to-school volume — even 150 agreements in the May–July window — that is 37–75 hours of billing labor per cycle doing nothing but moving data that already exists in Salesforce. Industry benchmarks for CRM + accounting integration (Bizdata360 / Salesforce, 2024–2025) report 30% productivity recovery and 60% reduction in data entry errors — consistent with what a comparable services company recovered when automating the same Salesforce ↔ QuickBooks invoice and payment sync: $25,000 in annual billing labor eliminated.

journey.headline: the path to answering 'what have we spent on Intensified Algebra Vol 1 over the last five years?' in Salesforce, without calling Holly

stage1.label: Connected
stage1.headline: Agreement-to-Invoice and Inventory in One View
items: Crystal stops manually creating QuickBooks invoices — when Abby marks an Agreement Closed Won, the invoice appears in QuickBooks automatically with line items, the correct state-based ISBN, and the customer account already matched
Crystal stops toggling between QuickBooks and Salesforce — invoice number, payment date, and open balance write back to the Salesforce Agreement automatically on a schedule
Holly's inventory quantities, committed stock, and projected shorts appear in Salesforce Inventory__c on a schedule — anyone on the team can see available stock for any title without calling Holly
Maria's cost-per-program question — 'what did we spend on Intensified Algebra Vol 1 over 5 years?' — becomes answerable from Salesforce without opening QuickBooks

stage2.label: Automated
stage2.headline: Shortage Alerts and Fulfillment Triggers Fire Themselves
items: When available inventory for a title drops below Holly's 3% buffer threshold, a Salesforce alert fires automatically to Holly and the responsible sales rep — before the shortage becomes a fulfillment problem
When a district's Opportunity stage crosses 60% probability, a pre-fulfillment reservation triggers in QuickBooks — reducing the manual crunch at back-to-school
Product catalog sync keeps QuickBooks items and Salesforce Products aligned — new title additions by Maria don't silently diverge from Abby's opportunity line items

stage3.label: Agentic
stage3.headline: AgentForce — Activated
items: An AgentForce agent monitors Salesforce open Agreements where the QuickBooks open balance has aged past 30 days — and drafts a follow-up email to the district's finance contact that names the specific invoice number, amount due, and program. Crystal reviews and sends with one click.

Maria's question — 'What did we spend on Intensified Algebra Vol 1 the last five fiscal years and what is left in inventory?' — is answered in seconds by an AgentForce agent reading the Inventory__c object and Invoice history that Phases 1 and 2 built. No call to Holly required.

An AgentForce agent runs pre-season demand forecasting weekly: reading open Opportunity pipeline by probability stage from Salesforce, comparing to current QuickBooks inventory levels in Inventory__c, and generating a draft purchase order recommendation for Holly's one-click approval — replacing the manual red-cell Excel exercise.

journey.closingLine: The Salesforce objects and MuleSoft event triggers established in Year 1 are what AgentForce reads in Year 2. That architecture is decided once.

flows.name: Salesforce Agreement → QuickBooks Invoice Creation
flows.value: When Abby marks an Agreement Closed Won, a QuickBooks invoice appears automatically — line items populated, customer matched, and the correct state-based ISBN resolved from the configurable lookup table. Crystal doesn't touch it.

flows.name: QuickBooks Invoice Status → Salesforce Agreement Sync
flows.value: Invoice number, payment date, and open balance write back to the Salesforce Agreement automatically on a scheduled cadence. Crystal's manual update step stops on go-live day.

flows.name: Holly's Demand Worksheet → Salesforce Inventory__c
flows.value: Holly's inventory quantities, committed stock, and projected shorts load into a new Salesforce Inventory__c object on a schedule. Anyone on the team can see current available stock for any title without calling Holly.

flows.name: QuickBooks Inventory Items → Salesforce Inventory__c (Cost Data)
flows.value: Unit costs for every curriculum title pull from QuickBooks into the same Salesforce Inventory__c view. Maria can see on-hand quantities and unit costs for any title — and answer cost-per-program and 5-year spend questions from Salesforce without opening QuickBooks.

outcomes.title: Hours Recovered at Back-to-School
outcomes.body: Crystal's 15–30-minute manual invoicing loop stops on go-live day. At AgileMind (Test)'s back-to-school volume — even 150 agreements in a 60-day window — that is measurable hours returned to finance every cycle, during AgileMind (Test)'s most compressed billing period.

outcomes.title: Inventory in One View
outcomes.body: Holly's demand worksheet and QuickBooks cost data both land in Salesforce Inventory__c automatically. Maria can see quantities, committed stock, unit costs, and projected shorts without toggling between three systems or calling Holly.

outcomes.title: AgentForce — Built on Phase 1's Foundation
outcomes.body: Maria's question — 'What have we spent on Intensified Algebra Vol 1 over the last five years?' — becomes answerable in Phase 3 by an AgentForce agent reading the Inventory__c records and Invoice history Phase 1 builds. The Salesforce objects DataSkate creates on go-live day are what AgentForce reads in Year 2. That architecture is decided once.

included.title: 4 Integration Flows — Built and Deployed
included.detail: UC1 (Agreement → QB Invoice), UC2 (QB Payment Status → Salesforce Agreement), UC3 (Demand Worksheet → Salesforce Inventory__c), UC4 (QB Inventory Costs → Salesforce Inventory__c). All flows delivered on CloudHub 2.0.

included.title: MuleSoft Hosting on CloudHub 2.0
included.detail: DataSkate manages the runtime environment, vCore allocation, and deployment pipeline. AgileMind (Test) does not manage MuleSoft infrastructure.

included.title: Field Mapping and DataWeave Transforms
included.detail: All DataWeave mapping from source to target systems — including the state × product → ISBN lookup logic for UC1 — designed, built, and documented by DataSkate.

included.title: Error Handling and Dead Letter Queue
included.detail: Failed events are routed to a dead letter queue with alerting. Crystal and Holly receive notifications on integration failures — no silent data loss.

included.title: UAT Support — 2 Weeks
included.detail: DataSkate supports AgileMind (Test)'s User Acceptance Testing phase — fixing issues, validating edge cases, and confirming all P0 prerequisites are resolved before go-live.

included.title: 30-Day Hypercare Post Go-Live
included.detail: Dedicated support in the first 30 days after go-live — critical for back-to-school period. QuickBooks OAuth token rotation (100-day expiry risk), edge case ISBN routing issues, and invoice sync timing are all covered.

oos.title: Salesforce Org Configuration and Object Provisioning
oos.detail: The Inventory__c object schema is designed by DataSkate, but creating it in AgileMind (Test)'s Salesforce org is an IT / Salesforce admin task (Chloe). Salesforce org licensing, Einstein / AgentForce licensing for Phase 3, and Education Cloud upgrade decisions are outside this engagement.

oos.title: QuickBooks Setup, Licensing, and Connected App Registration
oos.detail: QuickBooks licensing (including any Desktop → Online upgrade decision) and the Intuit Developer Console Connected App registration are client responsibilities. DataSkate configures the MuleSoft connector once OAuth credentials are provided.

oos.title: Holly's Spreadsheet Migration to Cloud Storage
oos.detail: If Holly's demand worksheet is currently on a local machine, migrating it to Google Drive or SharePoint/OneDrive is the client's IT responsibility (Chloe). DataSkate builds the UC3 integration connector once the cloud storage location is confirmed and accessible.

oos.title: Historical Data Migration
oos.detail: This engagement handles net-new data from go-live forward. Historical invoice records, payment history, and inventory quantities are not migrated from QuickBooks or Excel into Salesforce as part of this scope.

oos.title: Product Catalog Master Data Sync (UC5-potential)
oos.detail: The product/book title sync between QuickBooks and Salesforce (UC5-potential) is not in scope for this engagement. Maria's confirmation of system of record (QuickBooks or Salesforce) for product catalog is a prerequisite — promote to a future sprint once confirmed.

assumptions.assumption: QuickBooks version confirmed: Online, Desktop Pro/Premier, or Enterprise. Connector selection and architecture path differ completely between Online and Desktop — this must be resolved before architecture sprint begins.

QuickBooks Connected App registered at developer.intuit.com; OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Secret provided to DataSkate; QuickBooks sandbox company provisioned for integration testing; fiscal year April 1 confirmed in QB company settings.

Holly's demand worksheet confirmed as stored in Google Drive, SharePoint, or OneDrive — local machine files cannot be accessed from CloudHub 2.0. If local, file must be migrated before UC3 build can begin.

Google Service Account (Google Sheets path) or Azure AD app registration and Graph API permissions (OneDrive/SharePoint path) provisioned by Chloe (IT). Holly's column headers documented and stable before DataWeave mapping is written.
assumptions.when: Before UC3 DataWeave mapping is written

assumptions.assumption: Salesforce State/Country Picklist format confirmed (ISO codes e.g. US-CA vs free text e.g. California). A sample Agreement record showing the mailing state field value is required — determines the key format for the ISBN lookup table DataSkate configures.
assumptions.when: Before UC1 DataWeave mapping is written
